player_prompt.intro:
Nga ni Player {player_id} mu game ya Rock-Paper-Scissors ya mipindi {num_rounds}.
Lengo lyako ni kushinda mipindi mingi iwezekanavyo.
Mu mipindi yonse, njibu na mo ya: '[rock]', '[paper]', or '[scissors]'.
Ungaweza pia kutumia '[r]', '[p]', or '[s]' kuwa njia ya kufupisha.

message.round_win: Ifyasukile mu muputule: Uwa kwangala {winner} alicimfya!

outcome.p0_wins: Uwalelisha 0 e walicimfishe mu ma-awala ayengi!
